name: Abhinav Shrivastava

fitReason: Strong direct embodied-AI match through verified VLM/LLM scene-graph planning and learned perception integrated with physical manipulation. Added as a technical-fit candidate with zero visitor score; no open summer place is inferred from the current research.

physicalEvidence.summary: VeriGraph, ICRA 2026, explicitly documents physical manipulation in full §IV-F: LangSAM segments objects, AnyGrasp predicts grasp poses, and graph-verified high-level actions are converted to robot commands. Current PI-lab PhD students include the first author and another coauthor; all paper affiliations are UMD. The project lists physical stacking, everyday-object and tangram examples. Execution is open-loop after planning, not a learned closed-loop VLA. Robot make/model was not named in the inspected methods; no platform guess is made. Published planning percentages measure final-scene-graph correctness, not physical task success.
